title: Continuous self-motion reconstruction from simultaneous vestibular spike trains

evidence.supports: Original complete 49-neuron, 35-pair, three-animal target and exact animal-condition estimand; preserved without changing bytes.
Validated complete normalized case schema, equal-repeat/equal-group MSE, artifact-only mode comparison and explicit unverified execution flags.
Exact three-animal/49-neuron/35-pair census shape, genuine-pair versus singleton distinction, opaque case identity and normalized-reference limits.
Generated-control scope and missing authentic loader, comparator producers and protected runtime.

evidence.locator: Primary 2024 PLOS Biology article; source facts retained in the original reviewed registration
evidence.supports: Naturalistic and sinusoidal motion recordings from macaque vestibular-only neurons; 49 neurons, 35 simultaneous pair relationships, three animals.

evidence.locator: Borealis release 2.0; source inventory verified in original registration
evidence.supports: Versioned VO recordings and MATLAB analysis/simulation deposit; biological versus simulated records must be distinguished.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing source and generated engineering controls are preserved. No authentic model comparison, direct-observation trial, typed-viewer trial or human performance result is established for this registration.
excluded_claims: Direct neural interpretation, successful model performance or animal transfer from an artifact-mode label.
Published encoding/simulation analysis treated as an already qualified velocity decoder.

disposition_reason: The animal-by-condition velocity scorer is implemented for complete normalized prediction artifacts. No authentic MATLAB loader, neural packet, trained comparator producer or participant execution route is delivered; first reconcile actual pair/repeat clocks and the training-only phase prior.

scientific_target.question: Do genuine simultaneously recorded vestibular spike pairs reduce held-repeat angular-velocity error beyond the admissible training-only stimulus/phase prior, in each recorded animal and motion condition?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured angular head velocity at every valid native target sample of a complete held stimulus repeat. Reconstructing this measured trajectory is a neural decoding target; reproducing the paper’s encoding/correlation figures is not the answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Experimental motion signal in the versioned VO deposit; authentic units, sign, sample clock and repeat membership remain to be established from payloads.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete held stimulus repeat within an authenticated animal/session/recording group and motion condition.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three macaques; repeat, recording group, neuron and pair dependencies remain nested and shared-neuron links are retained.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-recording held-repeat decoding under a frozen permitted history. Leave-animal-out calibrated transfer is a separate proposed condition. Repeated deterministic stimuli can be decoded from phase alone.
exclusions: No claim of unseen-animal transfer from the current held-repeat scorer.
No general population precision or mechanistic proof from three animals.

inputs: Exact spike timestamps for each genuine observed pair or fixed training-selected spike-count bins, native query duration/timebase, and input-derived quality/core masks.
Training repeats and only explicitly allowed calibration; retain complete naturalistic and eight sinusoidal-frequency conditions with real availability accounting.
forbidden_inputs: Held velocity values, original waveform identity or absolute repeat phase when not in the declared information condition.
Tuning/filter/normalization fitted on held repeats; LIF simulations substituted for biological spikes.
observation_contract.case_identity: The scorer requires case id, group_id, condition, repeat_id and exact integer sample_ticks; groups retain animal_id, session_id, recording_id, neuron_ids and pair_id. Authentic values and opaque participant mappings are not supplied. A structurally valid asserted pair does not prove simultaneity.
observation_contract.split: Current component validates a supplied held-repeat reference and training_only prior declaration; it does not construct or authenticate splits. Freeze whole-repeat train/held groups and temporal buffers covering all model lags before producing artifacts. Secondary animal transfer requires a separate calibrated protocol.
observation_contract.coverage: Census shape is 3 animals, 49 neurons, 35 pair relationships and nine required conditions. Every animal-condition-stratum cell is represented, including unavailable cells with reasons. Groups are actual recordings, not necessarily 35 groups; single neurons are separate diagnostics. The authentic full repeat roster remains unresolved.

primary.name: Animal-by-condition vector of prior MSE minus candidate MSE
primary.aggregation: Mean squared error on each fixed valid repeat core; equal repeat means within each genuine simultaneous recording group; equal group means within each animal-condition cell. Report every cell without a cross-animal primary scalar.
primary.rationale: Requires signal-derived reconstruction to improve on the legitimate repeat-phase alternative while preserving the actual biological and condition coverage.

secondary: Raw candidate and prior MSE per repeat/group/cell.
R², Pearson correlation, signed bias, scale/intercept and sign agreement; constant targets keep MSE and have explicitly undefined variance-based statistics.
Sample-duration-weighted MSE and all singleton strata are named secondary outputs.

comparators.name: Training-only motion/phase prior
comparators.inputs: Only phase/stimulus information legitimately available in the selected access condition and training-repeat velocity.
comparators.procedure: Externally choose and freeze the strongest admissible prior using training/development only; scorer consumes one prior array and does not verify selection competence.

comparators.name: Wiener/ridge neural decoder
comparators.inputs: Same permitted pair spike bins, timing/history and calibration as candidate.
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent linear decoder; choose lags and ridge penalty on training-only grouped validation. No authentic fit is delivered.

comparators.name: Static firing-rate readout
comparators.inputs: Same observed pair, reduced to fixed rate features.
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only rate/tuning baseline to distinguish temporal coding gain from overall spike count.

nuisance_controls: Whole-repeat reassignment and within-pair temporal shifts preserving autocorrelation; identical replayed waveforms can make reassignment powerless and must be reported.
Phase/stimulus-only and spike-count-only predictions on identical frozen support.
Authenticate simultaneity, animal/session/cell identity and units/sign; keep the figure-specific 41-neuron subset distinct from the full 49-neuron census.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all three animal estimates and recording/shared-neuron dependence. The scorer computes no population confidence interval or significance threshold; bins, pairs and repeats are not independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing/extra/duplicate cases, shifted clocks, participant masks, nonfinite or incomplete predictions refuse the entire primary result. Predetermined unavailable cells remain explicit; never average successful cases only.

implementation.scorer_target: Exact complete normalized velocity predictions versus measured target and one supplied phase prior. It can subtract fixed_program and case_investigation artifact scores on the same reference; those strings do not certify either production mode.
implementation.delivered_scope: Pure standard-library evaluator and CLI for normalized assessor-owned references; generated census-shaped controls establish software arithmetic, identity checks and failure handling.
missing: Authentic VO_dataset.mat schema/clock/unit/roster loader and complete source-to-case mapping.
Qualified neural decoder and training-selected prior producers with source/exposure provenance.
Candidate signal transport, isolation, frozen-program/case-investigation execution logs and equal resource budgets.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing package documents generated controls only. This revision inspected code and contracts without acquiring signals or running a model.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed fixed numeric spike-raster/count observations over complete repeat cores, with timebase and declared history.
direct_observation.boundary: No numerical/model tools; preserve all samples via fixed tiling and score each core once. Derived rate displays would be separately identified substrates.
missing: Complete authentic direct packet and response transport; feasibility of full-duration numeric output not established.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed raster/time-axis display of the same spike observations.
typed_viewer.boundary: Restricted render/zoom/pan actions may reveal only declared input support, never velocity, waveform identity or hidden phase.
missing: No typed viewer, image transport or full-coverage response collector exists for this task.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical per-case decoder investigation on identical spike packets and calibration.
tool_assisted.boundary: Equal input/checkpoint/tool/compute budget, no target feedback; reset case state as declared. The scorer accepts a case_investigation artifact label only.
missing: No authenticated input or case-adaptive participant runner; label does not prove execution.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted spike-to-velocity programme and train-only fit/adaptation recipe.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code, preprocessing, lags and calibration before held-repeat access; scorer accepts completed arrays but never runs the producer.
missing: Complete programme training/inference harness, budgets and authentic comparator production.

summary: Makes the animal-condition prior-improvement vector authoritative and explicitly separates singleton diagnostics and authentic pair relationships.
Replaces generic direct/numerical access claims with actual artifact-only evaluator capability and missing participant delivery.
Keeps waveform/phase memorization as a mandatory comparator and preserves the three-animal inference limit.
revision.source_review: Original source-reviewed paper/deposit evidence reused; exact evaluator validation, score aggregation, comparison flags and normalized interface inspected. No new acquisition or model execution.
